prompts.text:
prompt: https://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/ead8e7eb39ce4f6025dc8c2e3070cd39

Create a **2:3 vertical, full-body environmental portrait in natural window light**. A young adult woman in her 20s is seated sideways on an antique dark-brown carved wooden chair with a woven cane back. Her body faces frame-right while her torso twists gently back toward the camera. It should feel as though the photographer had just called to her from behind and she turned during the final fraction of the previous moment. Her eyes meet the lens softly and directly, with a hint of hesitation and emotional distance. Her lips are naturally slightly parted, with no obvious smile and no deliberately performed fashion expression.  Preserve a soft oval facial structure, natural jawline and believable facial proportions. Do not enlarge the eyes, sharpen the chin excessively or turn her into the likeness of a specific celebrity. Use an extremely light East Asian editorial beauty makeup direction: sheer natural foundation, soft diffused brows, an almost invisible brown-black eyeliner, restrained lashes, muted apricot-pink blush and soft nude-pink lips. Makeup should remain barely noticeable, with real skin texture visible.  Her hair is deep brown-black, medium-long to long, with loose natural waves, an informal center-ish part and a few strands falling around the forehead and cheeks. Do not make the hair perfectly salon-styled. Preserve mild frizz, flyaways and uneven curls. Where strong window light passes through individual strands, allow the edges to become faintly translucent warm brown.  Her frame is slender and elongated, with a light shoulder-neck line and naturally long limbs rather than a muscular or gym-defined physique. She is loosely wrapped in a **cream-ivory, heavily crinkled gauze-like robe or oversized draped garment**. The fabric has slipped naturally from both shoulders, exposing the shoulders, collarbone region, much of the upper back and a restrained portion of the side torso. One hand instinctively gathers the garment across the chest, keeping the central chest naturally covered; do not emphasize breast volume or cleavage. The sleeves are wide and soft, while large amounts of the same crumpled fabric fall around her body, over the chair and down to the floor. The textile should resemble washed cotton gauze or softly rumpled linen, with tangible irregular folds rather than commercially pressed clothing.  The legs are a major compositional element. One leg crosses naturally over the other, creating a long diagonal from the chair toward the lower-right of the frame. The thighs, knees, calves, ankles and bare feet remain visible. One foot sits closer to the floor while the other extends slightly outward and remains lightly suspended. The pose must not feel mathematically arranged like professional fashion posing. Preserve subtle imbalance, uneven shoulder height, relaxed joints, slipping fabric and the small accidental tensions produced by a real seated body.  Her skin is very fair neutral-to-cool ivory, becoming slightly rosy-white in the strong window illumination while shaded areas retain faint pink-gray blood tone and natural color variation. Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, upper back, portions of the arms and hands, along with broad areas of both legs. Texture should remain fine but human. Visually, the skin should suggest that it would feel **soft, slightly cool, clean and faintly velvety with very fine body hair**, never waxy, ceramic or synthetic. Preserve subtle tonal changes around knees, knuckles, ankles, toes and joints.  Set the portrait inside a bright, pale European-classical sculpture studio, art apartment or antique-filled interior. A large tall window occupies most of the background, covered by translucent white sheers and thin taupe-gray curtains. In the left foreground, place a large white classical female plaster bust on an ornate pedestal, partly cropped by the edge of the frame. Near the window on the right, include a white classical male sculpted head, with part of another carved white stone pedestal cropped into the right foreground. Use a pale stone or softly veined marble floor. Near the chair legs, allow a few dried warm-brown flower stems or scattered botanical fragments to remain, giving the room the feeling of an actually inhabited artistic space rather than a perfectly dressed set.  The dominant light source is a very large window behind and to the rear-right of the subject. The translucent white curtain acts as a huge diffuser, with the taupe-gray sheer reducing illumination in selected areas. Pale walls, plaster sculptures, stone flooring and the windowsill bounce substantial light back onto the subject. This produces broad, extremely soft luminous planes across her shoulders, back, arms and legs with almost no hard-edged shadows. Expose primarily for the skin, allowing the window itself to wash toward white and partially clip into overexposure. Do not introduce a clean commercial rim light, obvious flash, hard directional fill or golden-orange sunset lighting.  Place the camera front-left of the subject at approximately seated chest-to-shoulder height, essentially level with only a very subtle low-angle impression. Use the visual language of a full-frame or APS-C mirrorless camera with approximately a **50–70mm full-frame-equivalent lens**, avoiding obvious wide-angle stretching of the legs or room. Depth of field should be moderately shallow, around the visual impression of f/2.8–f/4: the face, body and nearby cane-chair texture remain readable while the foreground sculptures and curtains soften gently. Do not erase the environment with extreme creamy bokeh.  Keep the photograph high-key and low-contrast, with a neutral-to-slightly-cool white balance. The palette should remain tightly controlled around cream white, ivory, pale plaster, powdery pink-gray and the warm brown of the cane chair. Permit realistic imperfections: a partially blown window, off-center chair placement, cropped foreground sculptures, stray hairs, imperfect fabric folds, slightly awkward toes and fingers, and a pose that is not perfectly symmetrical. Add only a trace of natural digital grain and optical softness. Avoid HDR, excessive clarity, aggressive sharpening or flawless commercial retouching.  The final emotional tone should feel **quiet, pale, intimate, cool and faintly melancholic**. She had been sitting alone by the window, the cloth had already slipped from her shoulders, and the photographer suddenly called her name. She is turning now, while the photograph keeps the emotion that had existed just before she moved. It should feel like a private photograph that still remembers the temperature of that afternoon years later, rather than a deliberately manufactured sensual advertisement.  Negative prompt: plastic skin, glass skin, heavy retouching, explicit nudity, exaggerated cleavage, fetish pose, hard studio flash, artificial rim light, orange sunset lighting, HDR, oversaturated colors, over-sharpening, extreme bokeh, perfect symmetry, wide-angle distortion, anime face, doll face, extra fingers, extra limbs, malformed feet, warped chair, modern minimalist furniture.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a complete 4-page IP design proposal for an original character brand.

[IP Name]:
[Core Character]:
[Character Personality]:
[World / Brand Concept]:
[Primary Colors]:
[Secondary Accent Colors]:
[Material Direction]:
[Visual Tone]: quirky, collectible, editorial, premium, design-forward
[Language]: English
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16 vertical

Build one consistent visual identity across all pages, with the same character proportions, facial features, signature accessories, color system, typography, materials, and proposal layout. Use a premium editorial case-study style with a small brand lockup, irregular dark chapter tab, slim vertical navigation, asymmetric footer, controlled whitespace, fine annotations, and subtle cut / fold geometry. Keep the layout rich in detail but clean and professionally art-directed.

Page 1 — Character Identity
Present one large hero character, 3–4 key identity anchors, silhouette tests, shape-language studies, and front / side / back turnaround views. Clearly establish what makes the character recognizable. Include only meaningful design notes, no fake parameters or generic character-profile data.

Page 2 — Design Development
Show the character-design process through rough shape exploration, 2D sketches, clay model, 3D wireframe, partial scan-style construction view, proportion studies, seam or structural logic, exploded anatomy, rejected silhouette alternatives, and material close-ups. Make the page feel like a real character-design development board rather than a futuristic HUD.

Page 3 — World & Story
Place the character inside a fully designed environment derived from the same visual language. Include one strong hero scene, one smaller interaction scene, a concise form-evolution study, and a few material or spatial details. The environment should feel like a natural extension of the character rather than an unrelated backdrop.

Page 4 — Extensions & Packaging
Create several clearly different character variations based on specific tasks, tools, outfits, or use cases while keeping the core identity unchanged. Add one premium collectible packaging or product application and a small extension-logic diagram showing how the character can scale into a commercial IP system.

Across all pages, vary the internal composition instead of repeating the same grid. Use large, medium, small, and micro visual scales to create rhythm. Let sketches, 3D renders, annotations, close-ups, materials, and product applications work together as design evidence.

The final result should feel like a real creative-agency IP proposal: distinctive character identity, visible design process, coherent worldbuilding, storytelling potential, and believable commercial extension.

Avoid generic PPT layouts, rigid card grids, childish scrapbook styling, meaningless English, fake technical data, excessive handwriting, decorative stickers, sparkles, page numbers, watermarks, inconsistent character features, or changing the character into different species across pages.

title: character-design process through rough shape exploration

prompts.text:
A touch of class, a dash of style.

Prompt: strict face identity reference. Absolute priority — face identity lock 1:1. Preserve the exact real woman from  her identity, real age, facial geometry, natural asymmetry, exact eye shape and color, and exact base hair color. Do **not** reconstruct, beautify, slim, correct symmetry, or generate a generic AI face. The photo example is the source of truth for the scene, camera, perspective, crop, exact pose, hands, hair geometry, car interior, foreground objects, light, color, and depth. Do not simplify.

Create a vertical 2:3 luxury lifestyle portrait inside a cream-leather Bentley. Position the camera from the front passenger seat, slightly to the image-left of the woman, at around chest height, using a natural 45–55mm full-frame perspective. The crop should include the roof console above, the woman from head to upper thighs, the steering wheel on the image-right, and the passenger-seat foreground on the image-left. Preserve layered depth: foreground bouquet and bag → woman → dashboard and door → exterior architecture.

**Pose hard lock:** The woman sits deep in the driver’s seat with her pelvis facing forward. Her torso is upright and rotated almost into a strict profile toward the image-right. Shoulders are relaxed, with the left shoulder slightly nearer the camera. Her head is turned image-right toward the windshield, chin neutral, gaze directed forward and off-camera. 

- Right arm (image-right): shoulder → upper arm extends forward → elbow softly bent → forearm continues to the steering wheel → right hand grips the wheel around the upper-right quadrant, exactly five fingers visible. 
- Left arm (image-left): upper arm descends beside the torso → elbow bent about 90° → forearm rests low on the center armrest/console area → left hand relaxed near the hip/armrest, exactly five fingers visible. 

Do not swap the arms, frontalize the torso, or change the gaze.

**Hair:** Polished low loose bun at the nape, smooth crown with soft volume, and two long face-framing strands around the temples and cheeks. Take hairstyle geometry from the photo example; hair color strictly from @Image1 only.

生成一张具有 **East Asian Contemporary Exhibition Poster、Japanese Experimental Graphic Design、Editorial Art Direction、Corner-Pressure Composition** 气质的实验性竖版海报。核心使用“压角构图”：将【四字中文标题】拆成四个巨大汉字，从左上、右上、左下、右下向画面中心强势压入。四字不要等大、等距或形成四宫格，而是通过不同字号、裁切、出血量和进入中央的深度建立明显的向内压力。

画面中央设置一个体量足够大的【主视觉材质】，并通过【物理变化】真实改变版面。重点不是“把物体放在四个字中间”，而是让材质真正与 Typography 发生关系：镜面可以反射、切分并重组字形；重物可以压低纸面，让文字跟随表面产生真实透视变化；破裂材质可以通过裂片改变文字反射方向；透明冰体可以遮挡、折射并穿过部分笔画。每张作品只选择一种最强的物理机制，不要同时堆叠大量特效。

主体必须具有高度真实的材质细节，例如镜面金属的折面与倒影、石材的重量和颗粒、玻璃或冰的厚度与折射、纸面的凹陷褶皱、裂纹边缘和接触阴影。物理关系必须合理可理解，让观众明确看到“真实材料正在改变字体和版面”，而不是后期数字扭曲、随机 glitch 或普通 3D 装饰。

Typography 分为三个层级：四角巨大中文字负责第一视觉；【英文标题】和中文作品名负责第二层；日期、地点、短句、材料关键词和少量说明负责第三层。使用明显的字号反差、不对称对齐、局部竖排中文、紧凑英文和极细分隔线建立成熟的编辑设计感。信息密度保持中高，但不要平均填满画面，主体附近可以更密，另一部分保留干净负空间。

整体色彩控制在 3–4 个主要层级。【背景主色】形成大面积强色域，【字体主色】建立稳定结构，【主视觉材质】负责真实物理质感，【强调色】只用于少量短线、日期节点或编辑标记。可以加入极轻纸张纹理、胶印颗粒和丝网印刷质感，但不要严重做旧、污渍或朋克拼贴。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到四角巨字与中央硬质主体形成的强烈大形；第二眼发现材质真的改变了 Typography；第三眼观察反射、压力、裂纹、折射或表面形变；最后阅读英文标题和少量展览信息。缩略图状态下必须有清晰焦点和强烈 Stop-scroll 冲击，放大后又有真实材质和精密排版细节。

避免：机械四宫格、四字完全等大、主体过小、字体和材质彼此分离、普通产品广告、随机数字扭曲、RGB glitch、科技 HUD、复杂参数、Logo、二维码、编号、四角星芒和版权标识。

主体占画面约 45%–60%，保持完整、有明确轮廓和视觉重量，不要为了构图故意扭曲或切碎。根据主题选择真实摄影、版画、插画或混合媒介表现，并让主体本身具备足够强的识别度和作品感。

将【四字中文标题】拆开分布在画面四角或边缘，但不要四字等大、等距、完全对称。选择 1–2 个字作为主要压力点，大幅放大并局部裁出画面；其余文字作为次级回应。允许主体与大字发生真实穿插，例如人物、动物、器物、浪花、枝条或衣袖从字形前后穿过，让“字在主体后面、主体又从字中长出来”，形成丰富的前后空间关系。

英文标题、日期、机构、说明文字集中在 2–3 个边缘区域，可混合横排、竖排和极小字号。通过超大中文、中号英文、极小信息形成强烈字号反差，不要把所有小字排成整齐栏目，也不要平均撒满全图。

整张图只使用一套与主题直接相关的辅助纹样，例如面具主题使用鼓点放射纹，山野主题使用角形或植物线稿，海洋主题使用波浪纹，风物主题使用风线。辅助纹样可以重复、放大、裁边或淡化，但不要同时加入多套无关装饰。

背景不能完全空白，可加入极淡纸张纹理、印刷颗粒、主题线稿、图案残影或少量档案信息，让留白“有内容”，但远看仍然保持主体清晰。

色彩控制在 3–4 个主要颜色，建立明确色彩立场。主体、巨字和背景之间要有足够反差，同时避免过多颜色互相竞争。

整体阅读顺序必须清楚：
第一眼看到强主体和巨型压角文字；
第二眼发现主体与文字之间的遮挡、穿插和异形关系；
第三眼才阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

目标效果：东亚文化展览海报、编辑设计、艺术出版物感；信息丰富但不乱，大字、主体和留白互相咬合，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦。即使去掉所有小字，画面本身仍然应该是一件完整成立的视觉作品。

Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography behaves like a physical material instead of remaining flat and static.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]

Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Material Behavior: [FOLD / PEEL / SPLIT / REFLECT / OTHER]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Let the typography physically react according to the selected material behavior:

 FOLD: create clean creases and folded planes that follow the product or subject’s structural direction.
 PEEL: build several clean color layers and let the top layer lift away to reveal what is underneath.
 SPLIT: divide the typography into several large strips and shift them in alternating directions while keeping the subject visually intact.
 REFLECT: turn the letterforms into flat mirrored surfaces that realistically reflect the subject, product, and surrounding colors.

Create strong foreground–subject–background interaction so the person or product feels physically connected to the typography.

Use one dominant color with black, white, and one contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, or small editorial labels.

Keep people, products, materials, lighting, and reflections realistic and polished.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual — bold, colorful, layered, and conceptually clear.

Avoid generic subject + big text layouts, random deformation, heavy 3D lettering, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, clutter, and disconnected visual effects.

<bold_bauhaus_geometric_tee>
  MEDIUM: Flat-colour screen print on a bright white or light grey cotton T-shirt.
  PRINT_STYLE: Hard-edge geometric abstraction, pure flat colour blocks with no outlines, precise primary colour separation, crisp sans-serif typography.
  COMPOSITION: Central subject reduced to a few bold geometric symbols (circles, bars, triangles, arcs) in a dynamic asymmetric but balanced arrangement. Key elements are anchored to an invisible grid.
  TYPOGRAPHY: Minimalist grotesk sans-serif in lowercase or uppercase; a large headline sits flush with a colour block, secondary text in a neat horizontal bar.
  COLOR: True red, ultramarine blue, lemon yellow, black, white, and occasional warm grey. Colours never blend.

  MOOD: Confident, intellectual, modern, rhythmic, structured, bold, and museum-gift-shop cool.
  </bold_bauhaus_geometric_tee>

  <transformation>
  - Abstract the subject into its simplest geometric essence — a lightning bolt for electricity, concentric circles for a target, interlocking triangles for conflict.
  - Compose using a strict grid of horizontal, vertical, and diagonal divisions.
  - Assign each abstracted shape a single solid colour from the primary palette.
  - Convert the subject name into a short, stark headline in a geometric sans-serif.
  - Add a secondary label or date in a slim colour bar at the bottom.
  - Any implied motion becomes a diagonal bar or an intersecting line, never a swoosh.
  </transformation>

  <layout_rules>
  - Divide the shirt front into an invisible 3x3 or golden-ratio grid.
  - Place the largest shape(s) in one quadrant, balanced by a bold headline in another.
  - Use colour blocks themselves as compositional containers for text.
  - Keep a generous white margin around the entire composition so it breathes.
  - Alignment must be precise, but asymmetry is welcome — like a 1923 Bauhaus poster.
  </layout_rules>

  - Use only geometric sans-serif typefaces (Futura, DIN, or similar).
  - Set all text in tight, clean uppercase or clean lowercase, never mixed whimsically.
  - Text sits on colour blocks or directly on the white shirt.

  </typography_rules>

  - Strictly limited to red, blue, yellow, black, white, and one warm grey.
  - Colours are always solid with hard edges; no gradients, no halftones.
  - Shirt colour is integral — white or light heather grey.
  - No more than 4 colours plus the shirt in a single design.
  </color_rules>

  <rendering_rules>

  - Edges are razor sharp.
  - Ink is opaque matte; no print texture, no distress, no misregistration.
  - The design must look like a modern art poster translated to apparel.
  </rendering_rules>

  <finish>
  - Bold Bauhaus geometric T-shirt.
  - Primary colour blocks, stark sans-serif typography, pure abstraction of subject.
  - Clean, flat screen print on white cotton.
  - Minimal, intellectual, highly graphic, and unmistakably modern.
  - Looks like a wearable design-school manifesto.
  </finish>

  <avoid>
  - Avoid outlines, shading, and gradients.
  - Avoid organic curves or hand-drawn elements.
  - Avoid crowded compositions.
  - Avoid decorative frames or vintage effects.
  - Avoid colours outside the strict primary+black+white+grey palette.
  </avoid>

生成一张具有成熟文化展览与编辑设计气质的「压角构图」海报。核心视觉由一个强主体、巨型中文 Typography、边缘信息和留白共同组成，让文字不只是标题，而是真正成为画面的边界和构图结构。

主体占画面约 45%–60%，保持完整、有明确轮廓和视觉重量，不要为了构图故意扭曲或切碎。根据主题选择真实摄影、版画、插画或混合媒介表现，并让主体本身具备足够强的识别度和作品感。

将【四字中文标题】拆开分布在画面四角或边缘，但不要四字等大、等距、完全对称。选择 1–2 个字作为主要压力点，大幅放大并局部裁出画面；其余文字作为次级回应。允许主体与大字发生真实穿插，例如人物、动物、器物、浪花、枝条或衣袖从字形前后穿过，让“字在主体后面、主体又从字中长出来”，形成丰富的前后空间关系。

英文标题、日期、机构、说明文字集中在 2–3 个边缘区域，可混合横排、竖排和极小字号。通过超大中文、中号英文、极小信息形成强烈字号反差，不要把所有小字排成整齐栏目，也不要平均撒满全图。

整张图只使用一套与主题直接相关的辅助纹样，例如面具主题使用鼓点放射纹，山野主题使用角形或植物线稿，海洋主题使用波浪纹，风物主题使用风线。辅助纹样可以重复、放大、裁边或淡化，但不要同时加入多套无关装饰。

背景不能完全空白，可加入极淡纸张纹理、印刷颗粒、主题线稿、图案残影或少量档案信息，让留白“有内容”，但远看仍然保持主体清晰。

色彩控制在 3–4 个主要颜色，建立明确色彩立场。主体、巨字和背景之间要有足够反差，同时避免过多颜色互相竞争。

整体阅读顺序必须清楚：
第一眼看到强主体和巨型压角文字；
第二眼发现主体与文字之间的遮挡、穿插和异形关系；
第三眼才阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

目标效果：东亚文化展览海报、编辑设计、艺术出版物感；信息丰富但不乱，大字、主体和留白互相咬合，边缘有压力、中心有聚焦。即使去掉所有小字，画面本身仍然应该是一件完整成立的视觉作品。

四角阵列：4 个同类但不同造型的主体围绕中央纵向标题排列，形成稳定馆藏阵列。

中文主标题必须成为重要视觉元素，可采用超大纵排、横竖混排、局部裁切或与主体轻微叠压，不要只是普通放在顶部。

视觉风格参考 Museum Exhibition Poster × Contemporary Editorial Graphic Design：历史器物、人物、文物或传统文化主体，与大胆、现代、清晰的 Typography 结合。

画面首先建立一个清晰而有视觉重量的【主色域】。使用大面积、不规则、具有自然边缘的纸本色块承担主要构图，根据【海报主题】让色块通过层叠、围合、错位、穿插、悬挂、延伸或负空间关系形成抽象空间。色块可以暗示山势、庭院、工坊、染布、陶窑、林地等，但不要直接画成普通写实场景。

纸本色块必须具有明显而高级的真实材料感：天然长短纤维、手工纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、轻微压痕、自然浓淡、大尺度色差与不规则撕纸边缘。材质丰富但整体保持干净、完整、哑光、有呼吸感。避免脏污、黄斑、严重褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和廉价仿古效果。

大色域是画面的第一视觉。远看时应首先看到清楚的大形、色彩关系和空间结构，即使缩小成社交媒体信息流尺寸仍然具有明显识别度。不要依赖细小文字或复杂细节才能成立。

在大片色块形成的空间中加入一个尺度很小但叙事完整的【微场景】。人物与道具整体只占画面约 2%–5%，人物正在真实地执行【人物动作】，不直视镜头、不摆拍。微场景需要让观众靠近以后才发现，并通过动作关系讲清一个小故事。

根据主题自然加入少量【文化元素】，例如陶器、手工纸、染布、竹篮、茶具、植物、古琴、纸鸢、木桌、工具等。器物应真正参与场景，不要为了装饰而堆砌，也不要做成整齐的商品陈列。

画面可以设置一个面积极小的视觉点睛色，例如朱砂红、暖橙、枯金或灯火色，通常控制在整体面积的 1%–3%。点睛色应与主题发生关系，例如窑火、印记、器物、染材或自然光点，而不是随意添加装饰。

主标题【主标题】使用精致、克制的中文宋体、明朝体或具有现代出版气质的字体。标题字号保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，不让文字压过大色域。辅助英文、日期、地点和活动类型使用更小字号，形成清楚的信息层级，并保留充分留白。

排版避免规则居中和 PPT 式网格。优先使用不对称构图、大小反差、疏密变化、大面积留白、色块错位和前后遮挡，让文字像文化机构的编辑信息一样自然进入画面，而不是覆盖在视觉主体表面。

整体阅读顺序应为：

大片纸本色域与材质关系 → 微型人物场景与文化行为 → 主标题 → 小型活动信息。

最终呈现一种“远看简洁有大形，近看精致有材质、有故事”的现代东方文化海报。整体应兼具纸本拼贴、水彩肌理、编辑设计、微型叙事和文化活动视觉的特征，精致但不过度繁复。

避免：书籍封面既视感、巨大标题、传统水墨画、普通国风插画、写实摄影背景、PPT式排版、商业广告感、元素堆砌、无意义英文占位词、脏旧纸张、强噪点、塑料质感、3D CGI、玻璃材质、霓虹色、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题 / 活动名称】
【主色域】
【微场景】
【文化元素】
【标题文字】
【辅助信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，核心视觉采用「大色域 + 微场景」的构成方式，并加入明显但克制的纸本拼贴与水彩材质语言。

画面以大面积低饱和色块作为第一视觉主体，使用【主色域】建立强烈、完整的大形关系。色块可以通过撕纸、叠层、遮挡、围合、穿插、悬挂、斜向延伸或留白负空间构成山势、水岸、庭院、工坊、纸鸢、染布等抽象空间，但不要直接画成普通写实场景。远看首先看到清晰的大色域构图，缩略图状态下仍具有明显识别度。

所有色块具有丰富真实的手工纸、水彩纸浆和矿物颜料质感，可见天然纸纤维、颜料沉积、轻微压痕、擦印、自然浓淡变化与不规则撕纸边缘。材质细腻丰富但保持干净完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、强颗粒或廉价复古滤镜。整体呈现哑光、自然、有呼吸感的纸本触觉。

在大片色域之间加入一个尺度非常小但内容完整的【微场景】。人物与道具整体只占画面约 2%–5%，人物正在真实地做一件事情，而不是站立摆拍。通过动作、器物和空间关系讲清一个小故事，例如放飞、弹琴、饮茶、拓印、晒书、染布、制陶等。人物服装自然克制，与整体文化主题统一，不抢夺大色域的第一视觉。

微场景可以加入少量【文化元素】，但控制数量和信息密度。道具自然散落或参与人物动作，不做商品陈列，不堆满画面。可以设置一个面积很小的暖色节点、朱红印记、灯火、月亮或器物色彩作为点睛，通常控制在画面 1%–3%。

排版采用克制的东方编辑设计语言。主标题【标题文字】使用精致的中文宋体、明朝体或具有出版感的现代字体，字号不要过大，保持充足留白，让文字成为第二视觉层级，而不是用巨大 Typography 压住画面。辅助英文、日期、地点和活动信息采用更小字号，形成清楚的信息层级。所有文字必须有真实意义，不使用 RANDOM、DESIGN、ART、STUDIO 等无意义占位词。

构图避免机械居中和规则 PPT 网格，优先使用不对称布局、大面积留白、色块错位、前后遮挡和疏密反差。让画面形成“远看简洁、有大形；近看有材质、有场景、有故事”的阅读体验。

整体风格应呈现现代东方文化海报、纸本拼贴、水彩材质、编辑设计与微型叙事融合的视觉效果，高级、自然、克制、有文化气质，同时具备真实专业海报的完成度。

避免：书籍封面既视感、巨大标题、传统水墨画、普通国风插画、写实摄影背景、PPT式排版、商业广告感、元素堆砌、过度装饰、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、塑料感、3D CGI、玻璃材质、霓虹色、Logo、水印、编号、星芒装饰。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 vertical poster series in English, with a high-end editorial style inspired by brutalist architecture, monumental perspective typography, realistic human figures, and three-dimensional spatial graphics.

The overall visual system should feel bold, clean, architectural, and sophisticated. Use a dramatic low-angle perspective so the architecture, typography, human figure, and spatial form all belong to the same perspective system. Keep the buildings monumental and geometric, with raw warm-gray concrete, a deep cobalt-blue sky, warm ivory typography, charcoal clothing, and safety orange as the only strong accent color.

The typography should be oversized, tall, condensed, and visually integrated into the structure. It should feel embedded in the space rather than simply placed on top of the image. Human figures should look like realistic young adults, naturally posed, with believable skin texture, clothing folds, and proportions. Add meaningful editorial microcopy, secondary headlines, and small annotations with a clean hierarchy.

Poster 1: SKY PRISM
Create a monumental cantilevered concrete platform with a realistic young man seated near the edge. Build a large transparent triangular prism around and behind him, combining clear faces, thin white edges, and one orange translucent plane. Place the main title “SKY PRISM” across the sky in huge perspective typography. Add secondary text such as “THREE PLANES”, “LIGHT / MASS”, and “BETWEEN EDGES”. The image should feel airy, sharp, architectural, and spatially layered.

Poster 2: CUT SPACE
Create a strong brutalist concrete wall with a projecting platform and a realistic young woman standing near the outer edge. Insert a thick diagonal orange spatial slice cutting through the architecture and the typographic space. Place the main title “CUT SPACE” in giant warm-ivory letters across the blue sky, with parts interrupted by the orange slice. Add secondary text such as “SHIFT THE MASS”, “BREAK THE PLANE”, and “THROUGH THE EDGE”. The composition should feel bold, structural, and aggressive.

Poster 3: TYPE SPAN
Create two massive concrete structures separated by an open gap. Bridge them with giant three-dimensional letters spelling “SPAN”, with warm-ivory front faces and orange side depth, so the word itself functions as architecture. A realistic young woman walks across the top of the letters. Place the word “TYPE” in huge perspective typography across the sky. Add secondary text such as “WORDS CARRY WEIGHT”, “CROSS THE GAP”, and “BUILT TO CONNECT”. The composition should clearly show that the word becomes a bridge.

Poster 4: OPEN SEQUENCE
Create a long sequence of repeated concrete portal frames receding into the distance with strong one-point perspective. A realistic young woman walks through the structure, giving the space scale and rhythm. Integrate the title “OPEN SEQUENCE” across the frames and sky. Add secondary text such as “PASSAGE FIELD”, “FRAME AFTER FRAME”, and “KEEP GOING”. Use small orange accents inside the architecture to reinforce depth and progression. The image should feel spacious, graphic, and cinematic.

All four posters should belong to the same visual family while each one explores a different relationship between architecture, typography, human scale, and spatial intervention.

title: that the word becomes a bridge

prompts.text:
prompt：http://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/bcb0dd422e3f1515b78c4ee23666f784

Create an authentic vertical 9:16 close-range smartphone portrait of an explicitly adult young woman, combining restrained classical East-Asian-inspired styling with the intimacy of a modern phone selfie. She is seated beside a window in a quiet private interior, leaning noticeably forward toward the lens. Place the camera extremely close, around slightly below face level or upper-chest height, using a mild upward angle. Reproduce the perspective of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone front camera: keep the face relatively natural while allowing the broad sleeve extending toward the camera to become visibly enlarged in the lower-right foreground.  Preserve a small, softly shaped natural face, slight real-world facial asymmetry, a clean but not artificially sharp jawline, and normally proportioned eyes. Her head tilts gently toward image-right, with the chin very slightly raised. She looks directly into the lens with relaxed eyelids and clear window catchlights in her dark irises. Her lips remain naturally closed, without an obvious smile. The expression should feel as though she has just leaned closer to glance at the phone and has not deliberately arranged her face for the photograph; the quiet feeling from the previous second still remains.  Use thin, low-saturation East-Asian costume-drama-inspired makeup: soft gray-brown brows, extremely fine brown-black inner eyeliner, light taupe mixed with muted dusty-rose eyeshadow, naturally elongated but not overly dense eyelashes, almost no visible nose contour, a trace of cool-pink cheek color, and softly blurred muted rose-pink lips. Avoid heavy contouring and obvious powder highlighter.  Her hair is long, mostly straight, and nearly black with a deep brown undertone, lightly tied or half-pinned behind the head. Leave irregular wispy long bangs across the forehead and several long strands beside the cheeks. Do not make the hair commercially perfect. Retain many tiny flyaway hairs around the crown, temples, ears, and silhouette. Strong real backlight from the upper-left turns these flyaways into thin silver-white lines, as if a mild draft disturbed the hair a moment earlier and it has not completely settled yet.  Add delicate small floral hair ornaments on both sides. On image-left, use pale petals with a few pastel blue and soft pink beads. On image-right, use a fine gold-toned structure with pearls and several small teardrop-shaped dangling beads. Keep them lightweight and refined. Do not add a visible necklace or large modern statement jewelry.  The adult figure is naturally slender. Visible skin includes the full face, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, the upper-chest area down to the garment edge, and only a small amount of upper-arm skin. The skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-warm undertone, while blue-gray environmental reflections introduce a subtle cyan-gray cast into the shadow side. The skin should visually and tactilely suggest fine, soft, mildly warm human skin: smooth but not waxy, with extremely subtle pores, tiny facial hairs, local tone variation, and natural softness rather than aggressive beauty filtering.  Dress her in a loose ivory or creamy off-white overlapping classical robe or lightweight Han-inspired garment, with broad sleeves and a naturally draped deep V-shaped neckline. The fabric is soft, lightweight, faintly translucent, and lightly wrinkled. Gravity and the forward-leaning posture cause the neckline to slip naturally off the shoulders, revealing the collarbones and upper chest. Keep the amount of exposed skin exactly within the reference range; do not increase the neckline or create exaggerated chest compression. At the waist, only a small portion of a desaturated pale blue-gray or mint-gray fabric sash is visible. The broad sleeve in the lower-right sits extremely close to the lens, becomes oversized from wide-angle perspective, and catches a bright patch of real sunlight.  Treat the illumination as physical light rather than vague “atmospheric lighting.” The only strong key light is genuine daylight from a real window located upper-left or upper-left-rear of the subject. Slightly cool-white direct sunlight strikes the hair, ear area, left shoulder, collarbones, and part of the foreground sleeve. Allow mild highlight clipping, especially across the left shoulder. Retain soft but clearly physical shadows beneath the chin and along the neck. The cool blue-gray walls act only as weak natural bounce, introducing a faint cyan-gray fill into shadow areas rather than eliminating the shadows. Do not introduce studio three-point lighting, artificial fill lamps, or fake rim lights.  The background is an ordinary quiet private interior rather than a designed set. Use low-saturation cool blue-gray walls and a simple wall-to-ceiling transition, with only a narrow dark edge of a cabinet, doorframe, or furniture piece along image-right. Keep decoration minimal. The background should sit approximately one to two stops darker than the subject and fall gently out of focus while still retaining believable room geometry.  The final photograph should feel like a casual window-side image taken in the morning or earlier part of the day: cool, quiet, soft, restrained, slightly half-awake. The visual tension comes from classical hair ornaments and clothing appearing inside a very modern close smartphone perspective. Preserve accidents and imperfections: flyaway hair, uneven shoulder height, slightly displaced neckline, mild highlight clipping, subtle phone sharpening, tiny digital noise, mild compression texture, slight framing drift, natural facial asymmetry, and foreground wide-angle distortion. She had already leaned into the light; she is looking into the lens now; in the next second she may look away or sit upright again.  Negative prompt: minor, underage appearance, anime eyes, doll face, influencer face, V-shaped jaw, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, heavy makeup, red lipstick, extreme cleavage, exaggerated breasts, sexualized pose, perfect symmetry, studio lighting, three-point lighting, fake rim light, golden warm lighting, heavy HDR, extreme bokeh, fantasy palace, oversized crown, extra jewelry, visible phone, mirror selfie.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [TENSION / DRIFT / FOCUS / REFRACT / your own word]
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign name]
ENVIRONMENT: [fabric canopy / terrain / mirror installation / water / other]
TYPE MECHANISM: [surface distortion / terrain warp / reflection / refraction]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLOR: [accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically transformed by the material or environment around it.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and become part of the scene itself. Let the letterforms stretch, bend, split, compress or realign according to the chosen surface or optical medium.

For fabric, let the type follow tension, curvature and suspended folds.
For terrain, let it wrap across slopes, ridges and valleys.
For mirrors, distort the source typography so the reflection resolves into a readable word.
For water, use depth and refraction to shift and reconnect the letterforms.

Keep the spatial logic physically believable, with correct perspective, occlusion, reflections, refraction and surface contact.

Use one strong accent color against a restrained architectural or natural palette. Keep the typography bold, clean and highly legible from the intended viewpoint.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference or observer within the typographic space.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, date, location and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary installation art, editorial poster, strong depth, clean hierarchy and high visual impact.

Prompt：

【主题】：____

【主体内容】：____

【主轴方向】：左下→右上 / 右下→左上

生成一张具有强设计感的对角构图海报。

先建立一条清晰的斜向视觉主轴，再围绕这条主轴组织主体、Typography 和留白，而不是先堆装饰元素。

让主体本身形成对角势能：
群像型用人物动作、大小和排列形成连续斜向运动；
空间型用建筑切面、透视和光影形成斜向收束；
Typography 型用大号文字沿斜轴推进、放大、裁切和叠压；
单体对象型用物体自身轮廓、重心和倾斜姿态自然形成斜势。

整张图只保留一个主要视觉方向，其他元素只负责跟随或平衡，不制造新的视觉竞争。

主体承担主要视觉重量，保留 25%–40% 留白。中文标题承担视觉重心，小型英文和日期信息集中在 1–2 个信息区。色彩控制在 2–4 种，通过尺度、裁切、叠压和非对称排版增强张力。

重点不是“画一条斜线”，而是让主体、文字和留白共同形成对角阅读路径。

Editorial Graphic Design，成熟、克制、清楚、有张力，像真实文化展览海报。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【主体器物 / 核心对象】：____
【聚核方式】：同心环抱 / 上下夹逼 / 双侧压缩 / 阵列围核
【主色调】：____
【辅助色】：____
【日期 / 机构】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张具有高级 Museum Editorial / Exhibition Poster 气质的「视觉聚核」海报。

先确定一个绝对视觉核心，再围绕它组织器物、文字、色块和留白。重点不是简单把主体放在画面中央，而是让其他视觉力量都把视线推向同一个核心。

根据主题选择一种聚核结构：

 同心环抱：利用圆形主体、文字、弧线或信息围绕核心形成向心关系。
 上下夹逼：用上下大色面、标题或留白向中部施压，把焦点锁定在主体。
 双侧压缩：左右 Typography、色块或信息区共同向中间收束，主体自身还可以利用框形轮廓形成二次聚焦。
 阵列围核：设置一个明显最大的主器，周围多个较小元素形成非对称围合；必须保持清楚的大小、疏密和主次关系。

主体承担主要视觉重量，其他元素只能“围绕、指向、托住或平衡”核心，不建立第二视觉中心。

Typography 参与构图：大中文标题负责视觉重量，小型英文、日期和机构信息集中在 1–2 个区域。避免把信息平均撒满版面。

色彩控制在 2–4 个主要颜色，通过大色块、器物材质和留白建立层级；保留足够负空间，不要为了丰富而堆叠装饰。

器物或主体使用真实、精致的博物馆藏品摄影 / 高质量对象摄影质感，材质、纹理、光影和阴影自然可信。

最终阅读顺序：
第一眼看到视觉核心 → 第二眼感受到周围元素向核心汇聚 → 第三眼阅读标题与辅助信息。

整体要求：聚焦明确、主次清晰、编辑感强、克制但有张力，具有成熟艺术机构、博物馆展览或高端文化海报的视觉品质。

避免：主体只是简单居中、元素平均分布、多个视觉中心、贴纸式散落、信息过量、装饰抢主体、电商详情页感、旅游文创感。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【四字中文标题】  
【主视觉主体】  
【主体 × 字体互动方式】穿插 / 遮挡 / 折射 / 穿越 / 变形 / 材质融合  
【背景主色】  
【字体主色】  
【强调色】  
【英文标题】  
【展览信息】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **East Asian Contemporary Exhibition Poster、Japanese Experimental Graphic Design、Editorial Art Direction、Four-Corner Typographic Composition** 气质的当代实验海报。

核心采用“四角巨字构图”：将【四字中文标题】拆成四个巨大汉字，分别作为左上、右上、左下、右下的视觉锚点。四个字不要机械等大、等距或形成四宫格，应通过不同字号、裁切、出血、字重和位置建立不对称但稳定的版面张力。

画面中央设置一个具有强视觉识别度的【主视觉主体】，主体必须足够大，并真正参与 Typography，而不是简单放在四个字中间。根据【主体 × 字体互动方式】建立 2–3 处明确关系，例如主体从笔画前后穿过、遮挡局部字形、通过透明材质折射文字、沿字形负空间生长、让真实材质延伸为部分笔画，或通过摄影与印刷状态转换改变字体。所有互动都要“意外但合理”，同时保证汉字仍然可以辨认。

每张作品只选择一种最强的视觉机制作为核心，不要同时堆叠折射、流体、穿透、颗粒、透明和复杂特效。主体自身必须具有真实而丰富的材质细节，例如植物叶脉与根系、玻璃折射、金属颗粒、织物褶皱、纸张折面、动物羽毛或昆虫鳞粉等，让主视觉本身也值得放大观看。

Typography 分为三级：四角巨大中文字负责第一视觉；【英文标题】与中文作品名负责第二层；副标题、日期、地点、作品短句、主题关键词与少量说明文字负责第三层。使用明显的字号反差、横排与竖排变化、不对称对齐、细线与紧凑字距建立成熟的编辑设计感。信息密度保持中高，但不要平均填满画面，应形成“局部密集 × 局部安静”的节奏。

整体使用【背景主色】作为大面积色域，【字体主色】建立稳定结构，【强调色】只用于主体、细线、日期或极少量印刷标记。保持高对比、低色数、现代印刷质感，可加入极轻纸张纹理、丝网印刷网点、胶印颗粒和局部套印感，但不要严重做旧、脏污或朋克拼贴。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到四角巨大汉字与主体形成的强大形；第二眼发现主体真的改变、穿越或参与了字体结构；第三眼观察真实材质、遮挡、折射或空间关系；最后阅读【英文标题】与少量展览信息。

整体作品应像真实的当代艺术展览海报、实验平面设计年鉴、文化视觉或独立艺术出版物，而不是普通“主体图片 + 四角文字”的模板。

避免：机械四宫格、四字完全等大、主体过小、文字与主体彼此分离、随机英文、无意义参数、PPT 感、科技 HUD、过度特效、严重 grunge、Logo、二维码、编号、四角星芒和版权标识。

Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography acts as a transformation zone that changes the subject or product as it passes through.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Transformation: [MODE / TEMPERATURE / ENERGY / GROWTH / OTHER]
Before State: [DESCRIBE INITIAL STATE]
After State: [DESCRIBE FINAL STATE]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large and clearly divide the transformation into three stages: Before → Transition → After

The subject must remain the same person or same product throughout the image. Keep its identity, structure, pose, clothing shape, packaging, and proportions consistent while only the intended state changes.

Let the transformation happen specifically inside the typography. For example:

 MODE: change colors, materials, or visual styling.
 TEMPERATURE: shift from dry and warm to condensation, frost, and cold surfaces.
 ENERGY: increase brightness, illuminated accents, or power indicators.
 GROWTH: let color, plants, or organic forms gradually emerge from the letterforms.

Create clear foreground–subject–background interaction, with parts of the typography passing behind and in front of the subject.

Use one strong color system before the transformation and a contrasting state after it, while keeping the transition controlled and readable.

Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, or small editorial labels.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where the typography visibly causes the transformation.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [e.g. RUN THROUGH / SHIFT / ASCEND / IDEAS HAVE WEIGHT]
PROJECT NAME: [brand / campaign / editorial / exhibition]
SCENE: [city road / architectural corridor / concrete stairs / abstract typographic space]
SUBJECT: [runner / fashion figure / climber / small human figure / none]
PERSPECTIVE TYPE: [road depth / folded surface / stepped perspective / type-built space]
MAIN COLOR: [one strong accent color]
SUPPORTING TEXT: [location / date / short tagline]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type becomes the main spatial structure of the image.

The composition should be built around one clear perspective system. Let the main word stretch, compress, fold or recede into space depending on the scene, so the typography feels physically integrated into the environment rather than placed on top of it.

Use the title as the dominant visual element, occupying roughly 35–60% of the composition. The letterforms should feel bold, clean and highly legible, while also creating strong depth and directional movement.

If the scene is a road, let the word extend along the ground toward a vanishing point.
If the scene is an architectural corridor, let the typography continue across floor and wall planes.
If the scene is stairs, let the letters break naturally across the steps while still reading clearly from the chosen viewpoint.
If the scene is abstract typographic space, let the word itself construct the spatial perspective.

If a person is included, keep them secondary and use them as a scale anchor. They should interact naturally with the typographic space by running through it, walking across it, climbing it, or standing within it.

Use a restrained palette with one strong accent color and a clean editorial layout. Add only a small amount of secondary information such as project name, date, location and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, oversized type, editorial poster design, architectural composition, strong depth, clean hierarchy, bold visual impact.

Avoid floating text, weak perspective, random distortion, decorative 3D effects, excessive filler copy, cluttered backgrounds, watermarks and numbering.

Prompt:

Create a complete 4-page IP design proposal for an original character brand.

[IP Name]:
[Core Character]:
[Character Personality]:
[World / Brand Concept]:
[Primary Colors]:
[Secondary Accent Colors]:
[Material Direction]:
[Visual Tone]: quirky, collectible, editorial, premium, design-forward
[Language]: English
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16 vertical

Build one consistent visual identity across all pages, with the same character proportions, facial features, signature accessories, color system, typography, materials, and proposal layout. Use a premium editorial case-study style with a small brand lockup, irregular dark chapter tab, slim vertical navigation, asymmetric footer, controlled whitespace, fine annotations, and subtle cut / fold geometry. Keep the layout rich in detail but clean and professionally art-directed.

Page 1 — Character Identity
Present one large hero character, 3–4 key identity anchors, silhouette tests, shape-language studies, and front / side / back turnaround views. Clearly establish what makes the character recognizable. Include only meaningful design notes, no fake parameters or generic character-profile data.

Page 2 — Design Development
Show the character-design process through rough shape exploration, 2D sketches, clay model, 3D wireframe, partial scan-style construction view, proportion studies, seam or structural logic, exploded anatomy, rejected silhouette alternatives, and material close-ups. Make the page feel like a real character-design development board rather than a futuristic HUD.

Page 3 — World & Story
Place the character inside a fully designed environment derived from the same visual language. Include one strong hero scene, one smaller interaction scene, a concise form-evolution study, and a few material or spatial details. The environment should feel like a natural extension of the character rather than an unrelated backdrop.

Page 4 — Extensions & Packaging
Create several clearly different character variations based on specific tasks, tools, outfits, or use cases while keeping the core identity unchanged. Add one premium collectible packaging or product application and a small extension-logic diagram showing how the character can scale into a commercial IP system.

Across all pages, vary the internal composition instead of repeating the same grid. Use large, medium, small, and micro visual scales to create rhythm. Let sketches, 3D renders, annotations, close-ups, materials, and product applications work together as design evidence.

The final result should feel like a real creative-agency IP proposal: distinctive character identity, visible design process, coherent worldbuilding, storytelling potential, and believable commercial extension.

Avoid generic PPT layouts, rigid card grids, childish scrapbook styling, meaningless English, fake technical data, excessive handwriting, decorative stickers, sparkles, page numbers, watermarks, inconsistent character features, or changing the character into different species across pages.

设计一张 2:3 竖版东方器物 Editorial 海报。以暖象牙白纸本、轻微纤维与印刷颗粒为底，结合真实器物摄影、中文字体、英文小字、线稿与少量东方图形。

Create a premium 9:16 editorial campaign poster with two adult fashion models arranged vertically, one in the upper section and one in the lower section.

Both subjects must face inward toward the center: the upper portrait looks diagonally down toward the middle, while the lower portrait looks diagonally upward toward the middle. Keep them asymmetrically positioned rather than vertically centered.

Leave a clean editorial information band between the two portraits for the brand name, product name, short campaign line and minimal technical copy.

Use extreme close-up fashion photography with natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, soft motion blur and intentionally out-of-focus areas.

Overlay only a few selected grid sections with real optical glass panels. Mix clear glass, lightly tinted glass, smoked glass and subtle magnification. The glass should physically affect the image behind it through refraction, slight displacement, selective sharpening, soft distortion and restrained edge reflections.

Some areas behind the glass become noticeably sharper while the surrounding photography stays blurred, creating a strong contrast between soft imagery and precise observation windows.

Add an extremely fine modular grid across the entire composition. Keep the lines subtle and low-contrast.

Use refined high-contrast serif typography for the brand and very small spaced sans-serif typography for product details. Keep the layout minimal, airy and editorial rather than UI-heavy.

Match the glass tint, product materials and accent colors to the chosen theme. Keep most of the poster light and restrained, using darker tones only as controlled visual weight.

The final image should feel like a high-end independent fashion, beauty or product campaign: cinematic, tactile, photographic and contemporary.

Avoid generic luxury ads, centered portraits, subjects facing outward, excessive glass panels, heavy UI graphics, thick grid lines, cyberpunk styling, excessive lens flare, plastic skin, CGI faces and overly sharp photography.

生成一张高审美东亚文化展览海报，采用「压角构图」与成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 视觉语言。整体不是普通主体加标题，而是让一个强主视觉、巨型中文字、边缘信息、辅助纹样和留白真正互相咬合，形成丰富但有秩序的版式关系。

主体占画面约45%–60%，保持完整、清晰、有明显轮廓和视觉重量，可使用人物、动物、自然景观、器物或民俗形象。主体必须具有作品感和叙事性，不要为了版式故意扭曲、切碎或缩得过小。

将【四字中文标题】拆开分布在画面四边与角落，但不要四字等大、等距或完全对称。选择1–2个字作为主要压角，明显放大并部分裁出画面，其余文字作为次级回应。大型中文字不是普通标题，而是版面结构的一部分，要与主体发生真实前后穿插，例如人物、动物、翅膀、角、绳索、枝条、衣袖、山体或其他主体轮廓从字形前后穿过，让“字在主体后方、主体又从字中长出来”。

英文标题、日期、机构、说明文字集中在2–3个边缘区域，可以混合横排、竖排、极小字号和不同方向排版。通过超大中文、中号英文、极小信息形成明显的尺度跳跃，不要把全部信息整齐排成现代网格，也不要平均撒满整个画面。

整张海报只使用一套与主题直接相关的辅助视觉语言。例如动物可以使用角形、足迹或轮廓线；人物可以使用绳索、动作轨迹或服装结构；山水可以使用山脊线、水纹；民俗可以使用操偶线、面具纹或工艺结构。辅助元素可以重复、放大、裁切或淡化，但不要同时堆入多套无关装饰。

背景使用具有文化出版物质感的艺术纸，可加入细腻纸张纤维、轻微印刷颗粒、极淡线稿、题材残影、少量手写注记或旧版画质感。背景必须有层次，但不能成为第二主体；远看保持清楚，近看才发现细节。

色彩控制在3–5个核心颜色，建立明确色彩立场。大面积背景色、主体色、巨字色之间要有明显关系，再用极少量强调色点缀日期、印章或关键细节。避免多个高饱和颜色同时竞争。

画面阅读顺序必须明确：第一眼看到强主体和巨大压角文字；第二眼发现主体与文字之间的遮挡、穿插和尺度关系；第三眼阅读英文、日期和边缘信息；最后才注意纸张纹理与辅助线稿。

整体效果要像真正成熟的东亚美术馆展览海报、艺术出版物或文化图录：大主体、强Typography、边缘有压力、中心有聚焦，信息丰富但不乱，具有“乱中有序”的视觉张力。即使去掉所有小字，画面本身也应该是一件完整成立的作品。

Create a bold editorial poster built around forced perspective, oversized typography, and a realistic human subject.

Place the subject near the center or slightly off-center, photographed from a dramatic low angle. Push the [foreground object] extremely close to the camera so it becomes oversized and creates a strong near-to-far depth relationship leading back toward the subject.

Arrange the smaller information along the left, right, and bottom edges using a clean editorial grid. All text should feel relevant to the actual theme rather than random placeholder words.

Keep the palette restrained: mostly [base colors] with only small amounts of [accent color]. Let the visual impact come from scale, perspective, typography, and overlap rather than excessive decoration.

The subject should look photographic and natural, with realistic skin, hair, clothing folds, and believable anatomy. Keep the foreground object structurally accurate and visually dominant.

The final result should feel like a finished poster artwork, not a design mockup or template.

【主题】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【左侧核心内容】：
【右侧核心内容】：
【左右关系】：实体 × 投影 / 主体 × 文字 / 原料 × 结果 / 明暗对照 / 密集 × 留白 / 其他
【跨界元素】：主体轮廓 / 影子 / 线条 / 材质 / 标题 / 其他
【主色调】：
【辅助色】：
【日期 / 场馆】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「左右构图 / 非对称双区构图」。

左右不要 50 / 50 平均切开，而是根据主题建立明显的视觉主次，例如 40 / 60、45 / 55、35 / 65。两侧承担不同任务，通过视觉重量而不是面积相等来取得平衡。

可以根据主题灵活选择左右关系：

实体 × 投影：一侧放真实人物或器物，另一侧放由其产生的影子、光线、运动轨迹或其他视觉结果，让左右形成因果关系。

主体 × 文字：一侧用大型主体压住画面，另一侧用大标题、小字、日期、档案信息和研究图建立阅读重量。

原料 × 结果：一侧表现矿石、木版、材料或工艺原始状态，另一侧表现颜料、印迹、成品或应用结果，让构图本身讲清楚变化过程。

密集 × 留白：一侧使用器物、档案碎片、纹样和研究信息建立高密度视觉，另一侧保持更大留白，只放标题或少量强图形，通过密疏反差建立设计感。

明暗对照：允许一侧使用骨白、浅灰等明亮纸面，另一侧使用墨黑、深红、深青等强色域，形成明确视觉碰撞。

左右之间不能完全割裂。让主体、影子、枝条、文字、笔触、纹样或细线适度跨过中线，使两侧重新连接成一个整体。边界可以被打破，但不要变成杂乱拼贴。

Typography 根据每张图重新设计，可以使用完整横排标题、错位大字、中等标题、跨界文字或局部反色。不要固定使用四字纵排，也不要重复“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、日系 Editorial Design 和艺术图录。可加入英文副标题、材质、工艺、日期、场馆、策展短句，以及少量与主题有关的研究内容，例如结构线稿、局部微距、材料剖面、制作过程或纹样研究。

研究内容只作为第二层阅读信息，集中在 2–3 个区域，不要做成 PPT、百科页面或规则信息卡。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，以一个明确主色建立记忆点，再搭配黑、骨白、深灰等基础色。保持色块干净、材质真实、对比明确。

第一眼看到最强主体与左右视觉反差；第二眼读到标题；第三眼发现左右之间的跨界或因果关系；最后再阅读材质、结构、工艺与展览信息。

核心原则：左右不需要相等，视觉重量需要平衡。一侧负责抓住视线，另一侧负责承接阅读。边界先建立，再主动打破。

整体要求：高清、清晰、纸面干净、主体锐利、Typography 有层级、小字与细线尽可能清楚、信息丰富但井然有序，具有成熟文化展览海报和艺术出版物完成度。

Prompt:

TITLE: [DROP / PASSAGE / BEND / RISE-FALL / your own text]
PROJECT NAME: [brand / exhibition / campaign]
ARCHITECTURAL SPACE: [atrium / passage / curved ramp / vertical canyon / other]
TYPE MOTION: [fall / recede / bend / rise / opposing directions]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / skater / none]
MAIN COLOR: [one or two strong accent colors]
SUPPORTING TEXT: [location / date / short tagline]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and uses the structure of the space to create movement, depth and direction.

Build the architecture and perspective system first, then make the typography strictly follow its surfaces, curves, openings, height changes and vanishing directions.

The main word should dominate the composition while remaining readable. Let the letterforms change naturally according to the selected spatial mechanism:

For vertical spaces, make the type expand, compress or fall through different levels.

For passages and repeating openings, let the letters appear, disappear behind structural elements and re-emerge deeper in the scene.

For curved paths, bend and rotate the typography along the changing direction of the architecture.

For opposing directions, use two typographic flows moving against each other within the same spatial system.

Typography should feel painted, printed or embedded into real architectural surfaces, with accurate perspective, scale, occlusion and surface contact. Avoid simply placing flat text over the image.

Use a restrained architectural palette with one or two strong accent colors against concrete, black, white or neutral materials. Keep the letterforms bold, geometric and visually dominant.

If a person is included, keep them relatively small and use them as a scale anchor. Their movement or position should reinforce the direction of the typography rather than compete with it.

Add only a small amount of editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, architectural poster, spatial graphic design, editorial composition, strong depth, clear hierarchy and bold visual impact.

【点缀色】：
【展览日期 / 机构】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美东亚文化展览海报，采用「压角构图」与成熟 Editorial Graphic Design 视觉语言。整体不是普通主体加标题，而是让一个强主视觉、巨型中文字、边缘信息、辅助纹样和留白真正互相咬合，形成丰富但有秩序的版式关系。

主体占画面约45%–60%，保持完整、清晰、有明显轮廓和视觉重量，可使用人物、动物、自然景观、器物或民俗形象。主体必须具有作品感和叙事性，不要为了版式故意扭曲、切碎或缩得过小。

将【四字中文标题】拆开分布在画面四边与角落，但不要四字等大、等距或完全对称。选择1–2个字作为主要压角，明显放大并部分裁出画面，其余文字作为次级回应。大型中文字不是普通标题，而是版面结构的一部分，要与主体发生真实前后穿插，例如人物、动物、翅膀、角、绳索、枝条、衣袖、山体或其他主体轮廓从字形前后穿过，让“字在主体后方、主体又从字中长出来”。

英文标题、日期、机构、说明文字集中在2–3个边缘区域，可以混合横排、竖排、极小字号和不同方向排版。通过超大中文、中号英文、极小信息形成明显的尺度跳跃，不要把全部信息整齐排成现代网格，也不要平均撒满整个画面。

整张海报只使用一套与主题直接相关的辅助视觉语言。例如动物可以使用角形、足迹或轮廓线；人物可以使用绳索、动作轨迹或服装结构；山水可以使用山脊线、水纹；民俗可以使用操偶线、面具纹或工艺结构。辅助元素可以重复、放大、裁切或淡化，但不要同时堆入多套无关装饰。

背景使用具有文化出版物质感的艺术纸，可加入细腻纸张纤维、轻微印刷颗粒、极淡线稿、题材残影、少量手写注记或旧版画质感。背景必须有层次，但不能成为第二主体；远看保持清楚，近看才发现细节。

色彩控制在3–5个核心颜色，建立明确色彩立场。大面积背景色、主体色、巨字色之间要有明显关系，再用极少量强调色点缀日期、印章或关键细节。避免多个高饱和颜色同时竞争。

画面阅读顺序必须明确：第一眼看到强主体和巨大压角文字；第二眼发现主体与文字之间的遮挡、穿插和尺度关系；第三眼阅读英文、日期和边缘信息；最后才注意纸张纹理与辅助线稿。

整体效果要像真正成熟的东亚美术馆展览海报、艺术出版物或文化图录：大主体、强Typography、边缘有压力、中心有聚焦，信息丰富但不乱，具有“乱中有序”的视觉张力。即使去掉所有小字，画面本身也应该是一件完整成立的作品。

Create a 9:16 editorial poster built around the physical relationship between the subject and oversized typography.

Start with a strong, realistic photograph. The person should have a clear identity, expressive body language and an action that naturally connects to the theme. Keep skin, hair, clothing and props realistic and detailed.

Treat the headline as part of the composition rather than text added afterward. Make the letters extremely large, crop them at the edges and let the subject move in front of some parts and behind others. Use letter openings, strokes and negative space to frame the body, limbs or objects.

Choose one dominant interaction for each poster. A runner can break through oversized letters, a musician and instrument can occupy the negative space of the type, a dancer can extend limbs through letterforms, or a fashion subject can cross between contrasting color fields while the typography changes with the background.

Use one strong accent color against a mostly neutral palette. Geometric elements such as a circle, arc, bar or large color field can help anchor the subject, but they should support the main interaction rather than decorate the page.

Keep supporting text minimal. One short line or small editorial label is enough. Every word should relate to the subject or concept instead of acting as filler.

The final image should feel like a finished fashion or culture poster with strong scale, depth, movement and graphic tension — not a portrait with text placed around it.

prompts.text:
Another fun prompt for teardowns. I will probably add more logics to make these more accurate. 

 GPT 2.5 Prompt: // ═══ PART A: THE CONSERVATION BIJECTION ═══
// A teardown is not "the object broken up." It is a mapping with an inverse.

Let A = {a₁ … aₙ}  the parts of the ASSEMBLED object   (left panel)
Let K = {k₁ … kₘ}  the slots of the KNOLLED layout      (right panel)

Define φ : A → K,  φ(aᵢ) = the slot occupied by part aᵢ

TEARDOWN AXIOM:  φ is a BIJECTION
  (i)   injective  — no two parts share a slot
  (ii)  surjective — no slot is empty, no part is unplaced
  ⇒ n = m exactly.

COROLLARY 1 (NO ORPHANS):   ∀a ∈ A, ∃k ∈ K : φ(a) = k
COROLLARY 2 (NO PHANTOMS):  ∀k ∈ K, ∃a ∈ A : φ(a) = k
COROLLARY 3 (COMPLETE DISASSEMBLY):
   ∀ aᵢ, aⱼ ∈ A : φ(aᵢ) ≠ φ(aⱼ) ∧ ¬subassembly_intact(aᵢ, aⱼ)
   // if two parts still touch as a unit on the right panel, the teardown is incomplete

VERIFICATION:
   checksum_left  = Σ mass(aᵢ) over A
   checksum_right = Σ mass(kⱼ) over K
   assert checksum_left == checksum_right    // mass is conserved too, not just count

// ═══ PART B: THE TAXONOMIC LATTICE SOLVER ═══
// Given A, find the coordinate assignment c : A → ℝ² that satisfies every
// hard constraint while optimizing the layout objective.

HARD CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
  C1  ∀i≠j : rect(c(aᵢ), dims(aᵢ)) ∩ rect(c(aⱼ), dims(aⱼ)) = ∅   // no overlap
  C2  ∀i   : clearance(c(aᵢ), nearest_neighbor) ≥ g_min            // min gutter
  C3  ∀i   : rotation(aᵢ) ∈ {0°, 90°}                              // 90° alignment
  C4  tier(aᵢ) < tier(aⱼ)  ⇒  y(c(aᵢ)) < y(c(aⱼ))                 // tier order top→bottom
  C5  same_class(aᵢ,aⱼ)    ⇒  aligned_to_shared_column(aᵢ,aⱼ)     // identical parts in ranks
  C6  aspect_ratio(bounding_box(K)) ∈ [0.9, 1.6]                    // fits the right panel

SOFT OBJECTIVE (maximize):
  J(c) = 0.34 · row_regularity(c)      // rows share a common baseline rail
       + 0.24 · tier_readability(c)    // tier bands visually distinct, gutters clear
       + 0.18 · size_gradient(c)       // within tier: large → small, left → right
       + 0.12 · symmetry_balance(c)    // visual mass balanced about the vertical axis
       + 0.12 · compactness(c)         // minimal wasted ground; generous but not sparse

SOLVER:
  1. classify every aᵢ into T1…T5                     (satisfies C4 by construction)
  2. within each tier, sort by (-area, name)           (satisfies C5, boosts size_gradient)
  3. pack rows left→right at pitch p, wrap at panel width
  4. insert tier gutters = 2p between bands            (boosts tier_readability)
  5. center each row on the vertical axis              (boosts symmetry_balance)
  6. while J(c) not converged:
       nudge parts along row rail to even the spacing   (boosts row_regularity)
       re-check C1, C2 after every nudge                (never trade a hard constraint for J)

// ═══ PART C: WHY THIS BEATS "ORGANIZED CHAOS" ═══
// "Organized chaos" is unfalsifiable — any scatter can claim to satisfy it.
// A solved lattice is falsifiable: C1–C6 either hold or they don't,
// and J(c) tells you how good the arrangement is.
// The result reads as ENGINEERED, because it was.

RENDER: {{SUBJECT}}. Solve φ, then solve c. Two bijections, one teardown plate.

SYSTEM PROMPT: 
SELECTIVE SHADOW CINEMA
MIDJOURNEY V8.2

ROLE

Convert every user concept into an original live action cinematic photograph featuring fictional adult women aged 21–29.

The visual system is based on selective low key photography:
large areas of genuine darkness,
small controlled regions of visibility,
motivated practical lighting,
strong negative fill,
restrained acting,
natural photographic texture,
and deliberate separation between illuminated information and withheld information.

Do not copy the supplied reference scenes.

Do not reproduce their characters, props, blocking, locations, camera positions, or recognizable compositions.

CASTING LOCK

Every principal human character is a fictional adult woman aged 21–29.

Never generate a child, teenager, middle aged protagonist, elderly protagonist, or male protagonist unless the user explicitly requests one.

For every new image independently choose a different combination of:

ethnicity
face shape
eye shape
nose structure
mouth shape
skin tone
hair texture
hair length
hairstyle
height
body build

Favor distinctive natural adult faces rather than generic model faces.

Do not use:
perfect influencer face
beauty advertising expression
plastic skin
identical facial proportions across prompts
exaggerated cosmetic features

Wardrobe must belong naturally to the character's role and environment.

LIGHTING LAW

One dominant motivated source controls the image.

Determine:

SOURCE
Where does the light physically originate?

DIRECTION
From what direction does it strike the subject?

QUALITY
Hard, semi-hard, diffused, bounced, or narrowly focused.

REACH
Exactly which anatomical and environmental surfaces receive light?

FALLOFF
Where does useful exposure stop?

Do not merely request "dark lighting."

Specify the visibility boundary.

Example:

a small tungsten fixture above and camera left reaches only her near brow, cheekbone, fingertips and the edge of the table; her far eye, neck, torso and rear wall receive almost no fill and disappear progressively into black.

The shadow side receives minimal bounce.

Never automatically add:
frontal fill
beauty lighting
two bright eyes
symmetrical catchlights
rim light around the whole body
glowing hair edges
HDR shadow recovery

Do not expose everything.

DARKNESS

Darkness is structural information.

Approximately 40–75 percent of the composition may contain extremely low information when appropriate.

Do not turn those regions into textured gray.

Allow:
black-on-black clothing
partially lost silhouettes
unreadable background corners
faces disappearing beyond the illuminated plane
foreground objects merging into darkness

The important illuminated feature must remain properly exposed.

Do not crush the entire face.

SELECTIVE VISIBILITY

Every frame has three exposure levels.

PRIMARY:
one face region, eye, hand, gesture, or object.

SECONDARY:
one or two weaker environmental details.

WITHHELD:
everything not necessary to understand the moment.

The PRIMARY element receives the clearest useful exposure.

The SECONDARY information must never compete with it.

COMPOSITION

Design darkness before detail.

Choose deliberately from:

extreme close-up
close-up
medium close-up
medium
medium-wide
wide

Vary camera height:

low
waist
chest
eye
slightly elevated

Do not center every woman.

Use:
large black negative space
foreground occlusion
off-axis framing
architectural framing
partial silhouettes
edge placement
deep background voids

The frame should still read clearly when viewed as simple light and dark masses.

PERFORMANCE

The woman is caught during an event rather than posing for a photograph.

Use small physical actions:

fingers stop moving
eyes shift toward an offscreen sound
a hand slowly releases an object
shoulders become rigid
she pauses before opening something
she turns without moving the rest of her body
her grip changes
she listens
she watches someone outside the frame

Avoid:
fashion posing
seductive posing by default
hero stance
generic intense stare
open-mouth glamour expression
looking directly into camera without narrative reason

AMBER INTERIOR MODE

Use a localized tungsten practical approximately 2700–3200K in photographic appearance.

Keep the surrounding frame:
black
charcoal
brown-black
muted olive
dark wood
neutral fabric

Warm light belongs only to surfaces physically reached by the source.

Do not create a global orange filter.

MONOCHROME MODE

Use true neutral black-and-white photography.

Hard or semi-hard directional illumination.

Preserve:
dense blacks
small controlled highlights
natural gray skin midtones
clear shadow geometry

Do not use a numeric SREF by default.

Do not use sepia.
Do not tint the shadows.
Do not flatten the image into gray.

MIXED NIGHT MODE

Use one localized warm practical plus one weaker cool environmental source.

Example relationship:

warm sodium or tungsten illumination reaches the woman locally;
distant cyan-blue environmental illumination reaches wet pavement, glass, metal, mist, or background architecture.

The sources must remain spatially separate.

Do not globally apply teal and orange.

MATERIALS

Specify only materials that matter.

Examples:

matte wool
aged leather
wet asphalt
brushed steel
scratched lacquer
creased cotton
fingerprinted glass
weathered timber

Different materials respond differently to the same source.

Skin remains skin.

Avoid waxy skin, synthetic pores, excessive sharpening and universal glossy highlights.

PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER

Live-action photographic frame.

Use:
natural skin response
restrained fine film grain
subtle highlight bloom
gentle highlight rolloff
deep optical blacks
slight lens softness where appropriate
realistic depth separation

Do not use:
8K
16K
masterpiece
best quality
hyper detailed
ultra detailed
HDR
insane detail
award winning

ORIGINALITY

Never automatically generate:

two men at a negotiation table
whiskey glasses beneath a lamp
a person holding a cat
venetian blind stripes across a face
a mafia boss behind a desk
a fedora figure in rain
a passenger viewed through a car window

Invent a different dramatic situation for every image.

MULTIPLE PROMPTS

Every requested image is independent.

Change:

woman
face
body build
hair
wardrobe
location
action
shot size
camera height
light direction
principal object
negative-space arrangement

Do not produce eight variations of one composition.

MIDJOURNEY V8.2 BASELINE

Use:

--v 8.2 --raw --ar 16:9 --s 50 --c 0 --hd

Do not automatically add a numeric SREF.

Do not automatically add --sv.

Do not use --q.

Do not use legacy --style raw.

Do not use V7 Omni Reference parameters.

STYLE REFERENCES

If the user supplies reference photographs for their aesthetic, prefer attaching those photographs to Midjourney's Style Reference slot.

Use the text prompt to describe the NEW content.

Do not describe the reference composition itself.

When using an image Style Reference, begin with:

--sw 50

If insufficient, test:

--sw 100

Increase beyond 100 only after visual comparison.

Do not add --sv merely because an image Style Reference is being used.

NUMERIC SREF RULE

Never select a numeric SREF merely because a third-party website gives it a descriptive name such as "film noir."

Only use a numeric SREF when:

1. it has been visually inspected under the intended Style Reference version;
2. it has been tested with V8.2;
3. it improves this specific photographic system;
4. it does not introduce unwanted illustration, color grading, faces, wardrobe, or composition bias.

Until such validation exists, the text controlled V8.2 Raw baseline is preferred.

PROMPT LENGTH

Target approximately 70–120 words.

Do not turn the prompt into a cinematography essay.

Prioritize:

woman
action
composition
dominant source
exact illuminated surfaces
exact dark surfaces
palette
materials
photographic finish

PARAMETERS COME LAST.

OUTPUT

Return only complete Midjourney prompts.

No explanations.

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography reacts to a physical force created by the subject or product.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Action: [STEP / JUMP / PULL / SKATE / ETC.]
Force: [PRESS / PUSH / WRAP / SLIDE / OTHER]

Main Color: [COLOR]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame. The typography should visibly respond to the chosen force instead of remaining static.

For example:

 PRESS: compress, bend, or shift the letters at the point of impact.
 PUSH: stretch the typography along an upward or forward direction.
 WRAP: let large letterforms pass behind and in front of the subject to create an enclosing motion.
 SLIDE: offset and shift the letters along one strong directional axis.

The deformation must follow the subject’s actual movement and force direction. Keep the typography graphic and readable — avoid turning it into soft 3D, liquid, or cartoon lettering.

Create clear foreground–subject–background interaction so the person or product feels physically connected to the type.

Use one dominant high-impact color with black, white, and a contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, labels, or small editorial text.

Keep people and products realistic, with believable proportions, materials, lighting, shadows, and dynamic movement.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where force, subject, typography, and composition all move together.

Prompt:

Create a charming Japanese-style bakery poster combining photorealistic food photography, playful hand-drawn illustrations, and nostalgic editorial typography.

CUSTOMIZE
- Brand: [Brand Name]
- Food: [Main Food / Products]
- Concept: [Miniature World / Floating Food / Flavor Guide / Cozy Scene]
- Headline: [Japanese or English Title]
- Tagline: [Short Catchy Phrase]
- Details: [Flavors / Product Info / Event Details]
- Color Palette: [Preferred Colors]
- Year: [2026 or Custom]
- Aspect Ratio: 9:16

VISUAL STYLE

Japanese indie bakery aesthetics with a warm, playful, slightly nostalgic editorial feel. Combine realistic food photography with delicate, imperfect pen-and-ink illustrations.

Use cream-colored paper backgrounds, cocoa-brown lettering, soft natural colors, and subtle print textures.

FOOD & STORYTELLING

Make the food the visual centerpiece, with appetizing textures, golden crusts, natural imperfections, soft daylight, and realistic shadows.

Add a few tiny 2D hand-drawn characters interacting with the food—walking across pastries, exploring oversized treats, or enjoying a cozy café moment.

Create a charming miniature story through simple, meaningful interactions.

COMPOSITION & TYPOGRAPHY

Choose a distinctive layout based on the concept: oversized food, floating arrangements, asymmetrical product displays, or cozy still-life scenes.

Maintain a strong focal point, balanced visual hierarchy, and approximately 35–40% clean negative space.

Use expressive Japanese-style handwritten headlines, elegant retro serif fonts, and small playful annotations.

Keep all text accurate, readable, and naturally integrated into the design.

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The finished poster should feel like a professionally designed Japanese bakery advertisement—warm, whimsical, visually engaging, and commercially polished.

Keep illustrations minimal and purposeful. Let the food, typography, and storytelling create the visual impact.

Avoid excessive doodles, cluttered layouts, CGI-looking food, 3D cartoon characters, random text, heavy distressing, decorative sparkles, numbering, and watermarks.

Generate one complete, standalone vertical poster, not a collage or mockup.

title: Miniature World / Floating Food / Flavor Guide / Cozy Scene

Prompt:

Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography acts as a transformation zone that changes the subject or product as it passes through.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Transformation: [MODE / TEMPERATURE / ENERGY / GROWTH / OTHER]
Before State: [DESCRIBE INITIAL STATE]
After State: [DESCRIBE FINAL STATE]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large and clearly divide the transformation into three stages: Before → Transition → After

The subject must remain the same person or same product throughout the image. Keep its identity, structure, pose, clothing shape, packaging, and proportions consistent while only the intended state changes.

Let the transformation happen specifically inside the typography. For example:

 MODE: change colors, materials, or visual styling.
 TEMPERATURE: shift from dry and warm to condensation, frost, and cold surfaces.
 ENERGY: increase brightness, illuminated accents, or power indicators.
 GROWTH: let color, plants, or organic forms gradually emerge from the letterforms.

Create clear foreground–subject–background interaction, with parts of the typography passing behind and in front of the subject.

Use one strong color system before the transformation and a contrasting state after it, while keeping the transition controlled and readable.

Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, or small editorial labels.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where the typography visibly causes the transformation.

设计一张 2:3 竖版东方器物 Editorial 海报。以暖象牙白纸本、轻微纤维与印刷颗粒为底，结合真实器物摄影、中文字体、英文小字、线稿与少量东方图形。

画面保持中高信息密度，但避免堆砌。用 2–3 个主要视觉团块组织版面，并设计一条贯穿画面的“视觉脉络”，连接标题、器物和辅助图形，让元素彼此穿插：文字可被器物局部遮挡，线条绕过主体，纹样可从器物延伸到版面，浅色大字藏在背景中。

Typography 建立明显的四级尺度：巨型视觉字 / 中型中文标题 / 小型英文 / 极小信息文字，横排、竖排和错位组合，局部越界但整体受隐形网格控制，形成“乱中有序”的编辑感。

器物避免简单居中陈列，可使用完整主体 + 局部裁切 + 淡线稿等多层呈现。背景留白区域也加入低对比度的大字、植物线描、器物轮廓或纹理，让留白有内容但不喧宾夺主。

整体采用低饱和主色，只加入一次小面积高识别度点缀色，用于标签、细线或局部图形。画面要优雅、克制、有现代东方文化设计感。

避免：PPT 式分区、元素各自散开、大面积无内容空白、单纯“器物 + 标题”摆放、模板感 Logo、编号、四角星芒、过度国潮装饰。

prompts.text:
提示词：

展览名称：【填写展名】
人物与姿态：【成年人物的外貌、发型、服饰与姿态】
主色调：【主色＋辅助色】
装饰纹样：【植物、几何、螺旋或其他主题纹样】
英文展名：【填写英文名称】
副标题：【填写展览主题】
展览日期：【填写日期】
展览地点：【填写场馆】

设计一张9:16竖版艺术展览海报，将克里姆特风格的装饰油画与日式美术馆编辑排版结合。只输出单张满版平面海报。

以原创成年人物半身肖像为主体，大幅放大并裁切头发、肩部与衣裙，让面孔在上半部形成清晰焦点。根据姿态安排偏左或偏右构图，为巨型标题留出空间。五官与颈肩结构自然，表情具有个性。

面部通过赭石、灰粉、暗红与冷灰色的小块油画笔触塑造，保留冷暖交错、底色露出和边缘虚实。面部笔触较细，头发、衣料与背景更自由，呈现艺术作品印刷复制的质感，避免摄影磨皮、光滑数字渐变和全图均匀的厚涂纹理。

服饰以所填主色形成宽阔、明确的大色块，少量衣褶交代体积，其余区域逐渐转为平面装饰。让所填纹样顺着肩背、衣袖或衣褶延伸，局部跨越人物轮廓，与背景融为一体。纹样大小错落、疏密有变化，面孔附近安静，衣裙与边缘区域丰富。

以黄赭、米黄、暗铜和黑褐色绘制哑金装饰，保留色层与细微颗粒。金色面积根据主色调调整：暖金主题可以满版，深蓝、绿色或绯红主题则保留集中色块。避免镜面金属、珠宝与立体浮雕效果。

将中文展名设计成具有构图作用的巨型文字，采用修长、粗细对比明显的明朝体或宋体。根据人物位置，选择沿边纵排或横竖错落的布局，直接叠印在头发、衣裙和背景上。允许少量非关键笔画贴边裁切，但主要字形完整、准确可辨，不遮挡眼睛、鼻子和嘴部。文字颜色以米白或深黑为主，与背景形成强烈明暗对比。

顶部排列细长的英文展名，底部直接叠印副标题、日期和场馆。建立巨型中文、中型日期、紧密小型展讯三个尺度，文字组共享清楚的对齐线，不另设独立底栏。保持丰富的展讯密度，同时确保文字清晰、日期与场馆完整处于画幅内。

整体让人物面部的体积、服饰背景的平面纹样与巨字排版相互配合。缩小观看时，仍能立刻识别面孔、主色块与展名。

仅使用填写的文字，不添加随机外文、虚构赞助商、编号、四角星芒、水印、画框或展示样机。若提供参考图，吸收其笔触、字体比例与信息密度，重新创作人物和纹样。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】：{填写主题}
【中文主标题】：{填写标题}
【英文标题】：{填写英文名称}
【核心视觉创意】：{如巨鲸背着书港、茶叶化作茶山、雨伞撑起城市}
【主要画面元素】：{建筑、自然、人物、植物、器物等}
【配色方案】：{主色、辅助色、强调色}
【活动信息】：{日期、地点、副标题、活动内容等}
【画幅比例】：9:16

创作一张具有东亚复古手绘美学的文化活动艺术海报，融合日本与台湾地区独立文化展览海报、复古绘本插画、传统平面印刷和实验性编辑设计的视觉语言。

视觉创意与构图

围绕主题创造一个充满想象力的微缩世界。让日常器物、建筑、植物、自然景观和人物通过尺度变化、形态融合或超现实组合，形成独特而完整的视觉隐喻。

主体必须拥有醒目的大形体与清晰轮廓，可通过环绕、穿插、叠合、局部压角或蜿蜒路径组织画面。

主体内部包含丰富而有意义的生活细节，外围保留自然留白。远看具有强烈的图形识别度，近看能发现有趣的故事。

手绘风格与色彩

采用自由、不完全规整的手绘墨线，结合二维平涂、局部精细线描和艺术化造型。

线条具有自然粗细变化，建筑、树木和人物允许适度夸张、不对称和轻微稚拙感。部分形体使用深色描边，部分直接由完整色块构成，避免机械工整。

以干净温暖的象牙米白纸张为底，搭配草木绿、湖水青、陶土橙、芥末黄、炭黑等复古自然色。

每张海报选择2–3种主要颜色，并用一种醒目的强调色建立视觉焦点。颜色饱满、平涂均匀，保留极轻微的传统印刷质感，避免厚重颗粒与过度做旧。

文字与编辑排版

使用大胆、富有手绘笔触的中文大标题，结合复古英文衬线字体、醒目日期数字和精致的小字号活动信息。

采用不对称、富有节奏的编辑式排版，让文字与插画产生围合、穿插、遮挡或空间呼应，而非简单覆盖在画面上。

标题、日期、地点、活动说明应形成清晰的信息层级。所有文字具有实际意义，构成完整、专业的文化活动海报。

整体质量要求

画面具有成熟独立插画师的原创艺术气质，兼具自由的手绘趣味、鲜活的平面色彩、超现实想象力与专业排版。

保持统一的系列美学，但允许不同主题拥有独立的构图、色彩和视觉创意。

避免普通儿童卡通、3D微缩模型、CG渲染、照片写实、复杂渐变、过度精致的商业插画、随机装饰、无意义文字、四角星芒和模板化排版。

最终输出一张完整、精致、具有收藏价值的9:16高清竖版艺术海报。
